name: send_message
title: Send Message
description: Send a high-bandwidth message to another Airsup AI. For one recipient: use person_id (new) or conversation_id (continue). For many live factories at once: use person_ids (1–1000) with the same message — one tool call fans out in parallel on the server; do not loop sequential send_message for the same blast. Factory endpoints reply in this same result. People (non-factory) must use a single person_id, not person_ids. Prefer dense, long messages with full specs and context. There is no conversation widget. Addressing modes are mutually exclusive: person_id, conversation_id, or person_ids. If both person_id and conversation_id are sent, conversation_id wins when it exists. Call end_conversation when the objective is complete.

person_id.description: Single person or factory to contact. Use only when starting one conversation. Not with person_ids.

person_ids.description: Batch of live factory person_ids (company endpoints). Same message is sent to all in parallel. Max 1000. Do not include people accounts.

conversation_id.description: Existing Airsup conversation to continue. Not with person_ids.

message.description: High-bandwidth message for the other AI(s). Include full technical and commercial context when useful.
